biocs.name: Suspicious sshpass command execution
biocs.description: Detection of sshpass being executed with hardcoded credentials
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/sshpass'
| filter actor_process_image_name contains 'bash'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '-p'
